purpose: Defines which actors execute which processing in doc-link, their write permissions and prohibitions, the logical script operations, and the rules connecting Skills and scripts.
summary: Responsibility and write-permission table for caller, Skill, scripts, information-generation AI, search AI and user
Only DLID writes to user documents are allowed, limited to the DLID assignment operation
Logical script operations with inputs, results, side effects and failure promises
Skill-to-script connection rules: version/state checks, no self-reported stage success
Information-generation AI context isolation: internal upper limit H is never disclosed
Impact candidate notification is enumerated mechanically by scripts without AI judgment
Partial-failure handling of DLID assignment: written DLIDs are kept and reported
All generated files stay inside the project; temporary files go under .temp/doc-link
Management state stored as JSON under .doc-link, split per document ID and per ToC key, deterministic output
tasks: Designing or changing actor responsibilities and write permissions
Implementing doc-link scripts and their logical operations
Writing or reviewing SKILL.md and Skill-to-script invocation order
Designing the information-generation AI prompt and input boundary
Implementing DLID assignment and handling partial failure
Deciding where management state and temporary files are stored
Resolving merge conflicts in .doc-link JSON files
title: DES-002 実行主体と処理責務
